items.answer: The tenant needs the Landlord's consent to assign the whole warehouse lease. The relevant clause states: "The Tenant may assign the whole of the Premises with the Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld" [1].

evidence.quote: The Tenant may assign the whole of the Premises with the Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld
